item.title: Meal - Chili Garlic Noodles
item.description:
Ingredients

  • Ground pork - 1/2 lb
  • Oil - 1 tbsp
  • Garlic - 6 cloves (minced)
  • Onion - 1/4 (finely chopped)
  • Noodles - 300g
  • Seasoning
    • Garlic powder - 1 tsp
    • Salt - 1/2 tsp
    • Pepper
    • Chilli flakes
  • Sauce
    • Soy sauce
    • Chilli oil
    • Brown sugar

Directions

  1. Cook the noodles and set aside
  2. Heat the oil in a pan and cook the ground pork until browned
  3. Add the garlic and onion and cook until fragrant and softened
  4. Season with garlic powder, salt, pepper and chilli flakes
  5. Stir through soy sauce, chilli oil and a little brown sugar
  6. Add the cooked noodles and toss well to coat
  7. Serve hot

Macros

  • Calories - 430 per serving
  • Protein - 18g
  • Carbs - 44g
  • Fat - 15g

Notes

  • Sauce quantities were reconstructed from the visible reel ingredients and usual noodle ratios

item.title: Meal - High Protein Hot Honey Popcorn Chicken
item.description:
Ingredients

  • Chicken breast - 600g (cubed)
  • Potatoes - 400–500g (diced or frozen cubes)
  • Greek yogurt - 150g
  • Cornflakes or breadcrumbs - 80g
  • Oil spray

Hot Honey Sauce

  • Honey - 2 tbsp
  • Hot sauce - 1 tbsp
  • Chilli flakes (optional)

Directions

  1. Coat diced chicken in Greek yogurt and seasoning
  2. Roll in crushed cornflakes or breadcrumbs
  3. Air fry at 190°C for 12–15 minutes until crispy
  4. Cook potatoes until golden and crispy (air fryer or oven)
  5. Mix honey and hot sauce to create hot honey glaze
  6. Toss cooked chicken in hot honey sauce
  7. Serve with crispy potatoes

Macros

  • Calories - 495
  • Protein - 50g
  • Carbs - 45g
  • Fat - 12g

Notes

  • Confirmed from reel caption and structure :contentReference[oaicite:1]{index=1}
  • High-protein “fakeaway” style meal
  • Very similar structure to KFC popcorn chicken bowls

item.title: Meal - Spicy Chicken Rice Bowl
item.description:
Ingredients

  • Chicken breast - 500g
  • Rice - 2 cups cooked
  • Hot sauce - 2 tbsp
  • Vegetables - 1 cup
  • Seasoning
    • Salt
    • Pepper
    • Paprika

Directions

  1. Cook chicken with seasoning and hot sauce
  2. Prepare rice and vegetables
  3. Combine into bowls
  4. Serve hot

Macros

  • Calories - 550
  • Protein - 45g
  • Carbs - 50g
  • Fat - 16g

item.title: Meal - Spicy Peanut Dumplings
item.description:
Ingredients

  • Frozen dumplings - 12 to 16
  • Spring onion - 2 sprigs
  • Peanut butter - 2 tbsp
  • Red curry paste - 1 tbsp
  • Garlic - 1 tsp minced
  • Ginger - 1 tsp minced
  • Soy sauce - 1 tbsp
  • Sesame oil - 1 tsp
  • Coconut milk - 1/2 cup
  • Chicken stock - 1/2 cup

Directions

  1. In a baking dish, mix together the peanut butter, red curry paste, garlic, ginger, soy sauce, sesame oil, coconut milk and chicken stock
  2. Add the frozen dumplings to the sauce
  3. Bake until the dumplings are cooked through and the sauce has thickened
  4. Top with sliced spring onion and serve

Macros

  • Calories - 360 per serving
  • Protein - 13g
  • Carbs - 36g
  • Fat - 18g

Notes

  • Macros are estimated from a 4-serving batch
